test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A hollow spherical shell is made of a metal of density 28 g/cm³. Its internal and external radii are 2 cm and 5 cm, respectively. What is the approximate weight (in kg) of the shell?

(Take pi = (22)/(7), Density = (Mass)/(Volume)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Mass** = **Density** × **Volume**

**Volume** of shell = (4/3) × (22/7) × (5³ − 2³) = (4/3) × (22/7) × 117 cm³

**Mass** = 28 × (4/3) × (22/7) × 117 = 4 × 4 × 22 × 39 = 13728 g

**Mass in kg** = 13728 ÷ 1000 = 13.728 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 13.728 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Internal radius (r)** = 2 cm

**External radius (R)** = 5 cm

**Density** = 28 g/cm³

**Formula Used:**

**Volume of hollow shell** = (4/3)π(R³ − r³)

**Mass** = **Volume** × **Density**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b4366c7f16788eb96595027fd24a82b17687dba197648dbba7af277fca7e953.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Volume** = (4/3) × (22/7) × (5³ − 2³)

⇒ **Volume** = (4/3) × (22/7) × (125 − 8)

⇒ **Volume** = (4/3) × (22/7) × 117 = 490.28 cm³

⇒ **Mass (in grams)** = 490.28 × 28

⇒ **Mass** = 13728 g

⇒ **Mass (in kg)** = 13728 ÷ 1000 = 13.728 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 13.728 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

**Volume of Solid Sphere**

The volume of a **solid sphere** is given by V = (4/3)πr³.

**Surface Area of Sphere**

The **total surface area** of a sphere is 4πr².

**Density Conversion**

To convert **g/cm³** to **kg/m³**, multiply by 1000. Here, weight is asked in kg, so we divide total grams by 1000.</p
